summaryStatement: Sixteen attacks were run against live bytes and all sixteen were refuted. Ten of ten cited digests recompute exactly, including the two occupancy digests, which were resolved to real paths by reverse hash search rather than by trusting a filename. The subject's two load-bearing currency claims survive an exhaustive COORD sweep: D-202 is the only recorded G27 leftover-join and D-227 the only recorded G27 occupancy, so v3-current-at-draft-time and occupancy-v2-current are both true, and every 'not current' recital about v3 is future-qualified. The no-cell-edit enumeration parses to exactly 170, 235, 237..251 with D-236 absent, and D-236 is confirmed at source to rewrite condition 2, which makes the exclusion mandatory rather than cosmetic. The one deliberate departure from the adopted D-251 template - recording that Claude Stage A carries no observationsNotFindings field at all - was verified against the live file and is the accurate row; copying D-251's three-string row would have been the false one. leftoverDesign holds at [OBL-G27-FX-AUTHORING], naming parent is D-153, naming v6 names no G27, required-now holds at 28, and the subject was byte-identical and 0444 at open and close. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX stand.
